sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Spooky Tripeaks is a Solitaire game, but don't let that fool you. The game has been tweaked and refined to create a unique experience that's both challenging and engaging. The gameplay revolves around clearing a deck of cards by creating sequences and suit stacks. Sounds simple, right? Well, it is, but the game adds a few twists that make it far more complex than your average Solitaire game.

One of the key features of Spooky Tripeaks is the use of jokers and bonus cards. These special cards can be obtained by interacting with the creepy characters that populate the game's haunted mansion. Jokers can be used as wildcards to complete sequences and suit stacks, while bonus cards offer a range of benefits, from clearing entire columns to swapping cards between columns. This adds an extra layer of strategy to the game, making it far more challenging and engaging.

But that's not all - Spooky Tripeaks also features a range of power-ups that can be used to aid you in your quest for victory. From freeze cards that lock columns in place to shuffle cards that randomize the deck, these power-ups can be a game-changer in the right situations. Of course, they can also backfire if used incorrectly, so it's up to you to use them wisely.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter increasingly challenging levels that will put your skills to the test. From blocked columns to locked cards, the game throws everything at you to keep you on your toes. But don't worry - the game is designed to be accessible, so even the most casual players can enjoy the experience.
